sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Hogger's Hogg Wild can be used to bounce back and forth between two blocks of
impassable terrain, dealing damage to all enemies on its path.
When appropriate, you can also create another temporary block of impassable terrain by casting
Loot Hoard on a target location, which opens up new angles for using
Hogg Wild.
How to aim Hogg Wild if you want to capture a Mercenary Camp as fast as possible?
The answer is different for almost every Mercenary Camp across all Maps because they have different statistics
and they are surrounded by a different shape of impassable terrain.
Use horizontal, vertical, or diagonal Hogg Wild angles to efficiently clear them.
The best Hogg Wild angles are horizontal or vertical because they can be combined with
Loot Hoard for covering a small area with Hogg Wild
and then continue by covering a bigger area when Loot Hoard ends.
You also need Mercenaries to be grouped as much as possible, so that they all take damage
from Hogg Wild at the same time.
While the general idea behind all the Hogg Wild angles is the same, you need to learn all of them
because they are all slightly different from each other. The difficulty changes based on how much
impassable terrain is surrounding them, if there are horizontal
or vertical angles to use, and how much Health and damage output the Mercenaries have.
This guide has been created with the help of Debug Mode, a special Sandbox for all Maps.
If you want to test out our Hogg Wild angles on a specific Map
that is not available as Sandbox in Custom Games, follow the instructions
provided in our Debug Mode Guide.

sections.title: Settings
sections.text:
When you want to clear Mercenary Camps, you can cast Hogg Wild
between two parallel segments of impassable terrain (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally)
or with the use of Loot Hoard on one side (horizontally or vertically).
Here are the recommended settings for efficiently clearing Mercenary Camps as Hogger:
Set your Keyboard Scroll Speed between 50% and 100%;
Disable Camera Follow (even if only temporarily);
Enable Force Move;
Configure Camera Turn hotkeys (only for diagonal paths).
50% Keyboard Scroll Speed is nice for placing Loot Hoard as close as possible
after tapping an arrow key. 100% Keyboard Scroll Speed is nice for quickly moving the camera away
before casting Hogg Wild.
If you prefer to play the game with Camera Follow enabled, you can press the [L] key to temporarily disable it,
clear Mercenary Camps as explained here, and then press the [L] key again to re-enable Camera Follow.
Force Move helps a lot because it makes it impossible to accidentally issue a Basic Attack command instead of
a Move command, so you will always move to the target location when you want to, even if there is an enemy there.
Sometimes, when trying to position for casting Hogg Wild, you will get
body-blocked by Mercenaries. When that happens, you need to issue additional
Move commands until Hogger reaches the desired location.
Camera Turn hotkeys are only useful for clearing Mercenary Camps where it is possible to
bounce diagonally, however, in this guide we only recommend horizontal and vertical paths
because they are easier to execute and similarly good.

sections.title: Execution
Siege Camp
sections.text:
You have to use Hogg Wild to bounce horizontally.
You start bouncing on Loot Hoard and then, once it expires,
you continue bouncing on impassable terrain.
Press the [E] key again to cancel Hogg Wild
when the damage from Staggering Blow
and Ez-Thro Dynamite can finish them off.
You can drink from the Healing Fountain right before starting to clear this Mercenary Camp.
The healing over time will keep you healthy against potential invades from the enemy team.

sections.title: Bruiser Camp
sections.text:
You have to use Hogg Wild to bounce horizontally
on Loot Hoard. Press the [E] key again to cancel
Hogg Wild when Loot Hoard expires, otherwise
you will move too far from the Mercenary Camp and lower your damage output.
Even though Hogger can clear this Mercenary Camp alone, the most efficient way to clear it is
to let Hogger kill the 2 Fallen Hounds while an allied Hero with good single-target damage
kills the Fallen Shaman. Hogger alone will bring the Fallen Shaman down to 50% maximum Health.
You should drink from the Healing Fountain right before starting to clear this Mercenary Camp.
The healing over time will keep you healthy against potential invades from the enemy team.

sections.title: Siege Camp
sections.text:
You have to use Hogg Wild to bounce vertically.
You start bouncing on Loot Hoard and then, once it expires,
you continue bouncing on impassable terrain.
Press the [E] key again to cancel Hogg Wild
when the damage from Staggering Blow
and Ez-Thro Dynamite can finish them off.
You need to group all Mercenaries towards the side where the distance between top
and bottom impassable terrain is smaller.
For doing so, use Staggering Blow horizontally from the side
to knock only 2 Mercenaries back.

sections.title: Bottom Bruiser Camp
sections.text:
You have to use Hogg Wild to bounce vertically.
You start bouncing on Loot Hoard and then, once it expires,
you continue bouncing on impassable terrain.
Press the [E] key again to cancel Hogg Wild
when the damage from Staggering Blow
and Ez-Thro Dynamite can finish them off.
Once in combat, the Wizard instantly casts an armor aura. To play around it,
you need to start with Ez-Thro Dynamite, wait for it to explode,
cast Staggering Blow, hit the Wizard with 3-4 Basic Attacks,
and then set up Loot Hoard and Hogg Wild.
You should drink from the Healing Fountain right before starting to clear this Mercenary Camp.
The healing over time will keep you healthy against potential invades from the enemy team.

Warning! Mercenaries that leash 3 times in a row instantly reset to full Health.
You need to either start slightly off-center or be ready to press the [E] key again to cancel
Hogg Wild before the third bounce on the top side happens.
For some reason, Mercenaries will leash every time you bounce there.
